audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer already states Vel'Koz wins every stage via poke range vs a dodgeable hook, matching the packet's level chart.
audit.why: Death Sentence is a slow single-target skillshot; Vel'Koz's Q/W outrange it and punish the long cooldown on a miss.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named an ability 'Tectonic Disruption' — that's Malphite's ultimate, not anything on Thresh's kit.
audit.why: Thresh's real cooldowns are Death Sentence (Q) 19/16.5/14/11.5/9s, Flay (E) 13/12.25/11.5/10.75/10s, The Box (R) 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: Death Sentence is 19/16.5/14/11.5/9s — dodge it and the lane goes quiet until it's back. Flay (E) is 13-10s and only threatens at 500 range. The Box (R) is 120/100/80s — save your own R to punish it, not to open.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles ('E the post-hook dive' and 'Beam through banked peel'), so the body doesn't answer the heading's claim.
audit.why: Thresh's lantern (W, Dark Passage) can yank his ADC out of Vel'Koz's channeled R mid-cast — a matchup-specific interaction the generic bleed text never states.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d -> punishing a whiffed hook with the full rotation; dontsFull[2].d -> checking the lantern before committing R.

edits.before: Q-fork the pair, W the pulse, third-hit the research — true math their page can't answer.

edits.before: - Vel'Koz vs Thresh - Track: Thresh Death Sentence. - Hold the root for the window that matters — one binding decides bot. - The duo goes when Death Sentence is down. - The R decides fights; it doesn’t advertise them.
edits.after: - Vel'Koz vs Thresh - Track his Death Sentence (19-9s cd). - Sidestep the hook, don't eat it mid-cast. - Hold R until his engage lands, then convert the pick from range.

edits.before: Zone with the threat — the root you hold governs more than the one you throw.
edits.after: You out-range Thresh from level 1; his only threat is the dodgeable Death Sentence skillshot, so poke with Q-E and punish every miss on its long cooldown.

edits.before: Window economy: convert the ganks, root the rivers, poke the sieges.
edits.after: Weave Q-E-W so his Damnation passive stacks fall off, and treat every missed hook as a 15-plus-second window to shove and zone.

edits.before: - Thresh Death Sentence: matchup-defining — The hook starts the lantern chain — dodge it and the playbook waits 19 seconds. It writes your spacing rules. - E Tectonic Disruption is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: Death Sentence is 19/16.5/14/11.5/9s — dodge it and the lane goes quiet until it's back. Flay (E) is 13-10s and only threatens at 500 range. The Box (R) is 120/100/80s — save your own R to punish it, not to open.

edits.before: Level 2-3 roots govern; level 6 hardens the playbook; first item funds the poke war.
edits.after: Level 2 Q-E burst punishes his auto harass hardest; level 6 your true-damage ult finishes anyone he flays or hooks; first item turns your poke into unanswerable percent-health drain.

edits.before: Carry by the root — one binding per fight; your carry does the arithmetic.
edits.after: Carry through poke: punish every whiffed hook with a full rotation, and land R the instant Death Sentence connects to convert his pick into a kill.

edits.before: You decide fights from range: root the entry, zone the pit, and bill the formation.
edits.after: Play behind minions and out of flay/lantern range — punish every failed hook with your full rotation and use R to convert his engage attempts before Dark Passage can save the target.

edits.before: Q-fork the pair, W the pulse, third-hit the research — true math their page can't answer.
edits.after: Punish the whiff: a missed Death Sentence is a free Q-E-W while it's on cooldown, up to 19s early.
